nodes.label: Instagram Media Publishing Workflow
nodes.rationale: Instagram rejects text-only posts, so writer skills produce caption/hook/hashtags/shot plan while the user supplies the image or video; publishing is always a media flow.

nodes.label: publish_media_post() 3-Step Flow
nodes.rationale: Create-post (draft, no scheduledTime) -> get-upload-url + S3 PUT per file, in slide order -> update-post to status=scheduled + scheduledTime. This exact order is mandatory since a scheduledTime set up front would race Instagram's scheduler against the S3 upload. On any failure after draft creation, the draft is deleted so no broken post group with an abandoned upload is left behind.

nodes.label: Media Container Rules (image/carousel/reel/story mapping)
nodes.rationale: 1 image -> photo post; 2-10 images -> carousel; 1 video -> Reel by default or Story via videoType STORIES; mixed images+video is rejected by the API.
